stem: Chlorine reacts with cold aqueous sodium hydroxide: Cl2 + 2NaOH -> NaCl + NaClO + H2O. Which explanation correctly shows why this is disproportionation? Enter 1, 2 or 3. (1) Chlorine is reduced from 0 in Cl2 to -1 in NaCl and oxidised from 0 in Cl2 to +1 in NaClO in the same reaction. (2) Chlorine is oxidised from 0 to +1 in both NaCl and NaClO. (3) Chlorine is reduced from 0 to -1 in both NaCl and NaClO.
